facts.hand-cup: A hand coming out of a cloud on the right holds up a gold cup on its palm.
facts.five-streams: Five streams of water overflow from the cup and fall into the pond below.
facts.dove-wafer: A white dove carrying a round wafer marked with a cross in its beak descends over the cup.
facts.drops: Drops of water scatter and fall around the cup.
facts.lily-pond: Water lily leaves and red flowers float on the pond below.
facts.letter: A single letter-like mark is engraved on the body of the cup.
facts.hand-glow: Pale rays of light spread around the hand.

glosses.five-streams: Feeling that fills the cup and still overflows.

reversedGloss.blocked: The heart cannot flow and is blocked.
reversedGloss.internalized: Feeling is not expressed outwardly and only fills up inside.
reversedGloss.excess: Feeling overflows and is hard to bear.

misdescriptions.wrong: A hand comes out of a cloud on the left.
